proposal.reason: Main change is review-routing policy/automation behavior, so workflow owns it over any runtime module. Evidence: .github/scripts/review_automation.py adds typed review-request withdrawal with REST->GraphQL fallback, snapshot/conflict checks, and classification freshness keyed to pr_number+head_sha with optional base_ref; .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py enforces the new freshness gate and removes diff-fingerprint revalidation; .github/scripts/reviewer_api.py adds GraphQL client/error handling; .github/WORKFLOWS.md documents the updated gate boundary and refresh policy.
